title: Step 2 - Reinforcement Learning: Thompson Sampling Outperforms UCB Algorithm

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this, our tutorial.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: So in the previous tutorial we implemented Thompson sampling from scratch.
cues.zh: 上一堂從零實作 Thompson 抽樣。

cues.en: And now, time for the moment we've all been waiting for let's see if Thompson sampling can beat UCB.
cues.zh: 現在是等待已久的時刻，看看能否勝過 UCB。

cues.en: So in fact, we are ready to execute this code section here and find out about the final result.
cues.zh: 準備執行這區段，揭曉最終結果。

cues.en: So let's remember the random selection gave us a total reward of 1,200, on average.
cues.zh: 記得隨機選擇平均總獎勵 1,200。

cues.en: The UCB algorithm gave us a total reward of 2,178.
cues.zh: UCB 是 2,178。

cues.en: And now let's see if Thompson sampling can beat that.
cues.zh: 看看 Thompson 抽樣能否勝過。

cues.en: Now let's select everything from here to the top because, you know, we haven't imported the data set.
cues.zh: 從這裡選到最上方，因為還沒匯入資料集。

cues.en: So, we will execute everything all in once to immediately get this final result that we're so excited to find out about.
cues.zh: 一次執行全部，立刻取得期待的最終結果。

cues.en: So, ready?
cues.zh: 準備好嗎？

cues.en: I'm going to press command plus enter to execute and let's see who is the big winner.
cues.zh: 按 Command 加 Enter，看看誰是大贏家。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 來了。

cues.en: And it turns out to be Thompson sampling because we got a total reward of 2,602.
cues.zh: 結果是 Thompson 抽樣，總獎勵 2,602。

cues.en: So we have some random factors.
cues.zh: 不過有隨機因素。

cues.en: So let's not scream victory yet.
cues.zh: 先別急著歡呼。

cues.en: We are going to execute that again to see the new total reward.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，看看新總獎勵。

cues.en: Well, we get 2,600 almost.
We can do that again.
cues.zh: 再來一次。

cues.en: And, basically, it's averaging around 2,600.
cues.zh: 基本上平均約 2,600。

cues.en: So yes, definitely, it's beating the upper confidence bound algorithm.
cues.zh: 所以確實勝過 UCB。

cues.en: And by the way, remember that with the UCB algorithm we almost doubled the total reward of the random selection algorithm.
cues.zh: 記得 UCB 幾乎是隨機選擇總獎勵的兩倍。

cues.en: But now with Thompson sampling we're not only beating the UCB algorithm, we're also, we're doing better than doubling the random selection total reward.
cues.zh: 現在 Thompson 抽樣不只勝過 UCB，也超過隨機總獎勵的兩倍。

cues.en: Because we get this 2,600 total reward on average, which is more than the double of 1,200.
That's what's the total reward of the random selection algorithm on average.
cues.zh: 1,200 是隨機選擇平均總獎勵。

cues.en: So great, definitely Thompson sampling is the big winner.
cues.zh: 很好，Thompson 抽樣確實大贏。

cues.en: And now we have last thing to check.
cues.zh: 還有最後一項檢查。

cues.en: You know, remember we need to check that Thompson sampling also gives us the best ad that has the highest conversion rate, you know, on which the users of the social network would click the most.
cues.zh: 記得也要確認它提供最佳、轉換率最高的廣告，也就是社群平台使用者點最多的。

cues.en: And so we need to make sure that it's also the ad version number five, which was the ad version found by the UCB algorithm.
cues.zh: 確認是不是 UCB 找出的第五版。

cues.en: And to check that out very efficiently, we can select this code section here and execute to look at the histogram.
cues.zh: 有效率地檢查，選這段執行，看分布圖。

cues.en: And here we go.
cues.zh: 出來了。

cues.en: We also get that the ad version that was most selected is ad version number five.
cues.zh: 一樣，被選最多的是第五版。

cues.en: And by the way, in UCB, we had some higher bars here if I remember correctly.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，沒記錯的話 UCB 這些其他長條較高。

cues.en: But here, with Thompson sampling we can clearly see that this was this ad version number five here that was most selected.
cues.zh: 這裡 Thompson 抽樣明確顯示，第五版被選最多。

cues.en: You know, this bar here corresponding to the ad version number five, is clearly dominating the other bars.
cues.zh: 對應第五版的這根長條，明顯壓倒其他。

cues.en: And that's because Thompson sampling quickly figured out which ad is the best to select.
cues.zh: 因為 Thompson 抽樣很快找到最佳選擇。

cues.en: That is it quickly figured out which ad has the best click-through rate.
cues.zh: 快速找出哪個點閱率最高。

cues.en: And so now we can congratulate ourselves because we clearly solved, very efficiently, this click-through rate optimization problem.
cues.zh: 所以可以恭喜自己，非常有效率地解決點閱率最佳化問題。

cues.en: And the best algorithm that we found for this is Thompson sampling.
cues.zh: 找到最好的演算法是 Thompson 抽樣。

cues.en: All right, so congratulations for having implemented these two algorithms, UCB and Thompson sampling.
cues.zh: 恭喜實作 UCB 與 Thompson 抽樣兩個演算法。

cues.en: That's the end of this section.
cues.zh: 這單元結束。

cues.en: And that's also the end of this part, reinforcement learning.
cues.zh: 強化學習這部分也結束。

cues.en: So I look forward to seeing you in the next part, natural language processing.
cues.zh: 期待下一部分「自然語言處理」再見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy much learning!
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
